question.question: If a constricted card reaches slot 1 or 2, can it be used, and can it instead take an X-token?

fixed_key.expected_answer: Its regular action has strength −1 or 0 and cannot be performed as is. Spend enough X-tokens to reach at least strength 1, wait until it reaches slot 3, or use the alternative X-token action if below the holding cap.
material_requested_facts: Its regular action has strength −1 or 0 and cannot be performed as is.
Spend enough X-tokens to reach at least strength 1, wait until it reaches slot 3, or use the alternative X-token action if below the holding cap.

a.answer: 1. Constricted slot 1 or 2: the summary does not state whether such a card can be used or must be left unused. It states only that an affected action loses two strength, and for effective strength zero or below, use enough X-tokens to reach at least one, use the alternative X-token action, or leave the card until at least slot 3. 2. X-token alternative: explicitly listed as an option when effective strength is zero or below.
a.evidence: “An affected action loses two strength; this applies to each execution of a multiplied action. X-tokens can restore strength. At effective strength zero or below, use enough X-tokens to reach at least one, use the alternative X-token action, or leave the card until it is at least in slot 3.”

b.answer: 1. Slot 1 or 2: a constricted card at effective strength zero or below cannot be used as a regular action unless you spend enough X-tokens to reach at least strength 1. 2. Alternatives: you may use the alternative X-token action or leave the card until it is at least in slot 3.
evidence: At effective strength zero or below, use enough X-tokens to reach at least one, use the alternative X-token action, or leave the card until it is at least in slot 3.
